items.text: Lazy-loaded release history — the ★ modal shows the latest release immediately and loads older releases as you scroll; a skeleton appears while data is fetched.
Lighter first paint — modal logic loads on first open via whats-new-stub.js; per-release content is served from /static/data/whats-new/ JSON files.
Inline shortcut conflict — cross-page shortcut warnings only apply when Global shortcuts is enabled; per-page shortcuts no longer false-positive on other pages.
Category order on page switch — debounced category reorder flushes before loading another page so order is not lost within the 1s save window.
Open tracking — middle-click on a bookmark row increments openCount and smart-collection recency (primary click and keyboard Enter already did).
Page-scoped saves — bookmark and category POSTs capture the page id and payload at save start; in-flight writes finish before page switch so reorder data cannot land on the wrong page.
Move popover — Shift+M outside-click and Escape listeners clean up correctly; toggling the popover closed no longer leaks global key handlers.
Smart collections after open — opening a bookmark refreshes smart-collection sections only (when enabled) instead of rebuilding the whole dashboard; skipped during inline edit.
Find & launcher search — interleave/find matches bookmark names via .bookmark-text; launcher dimming compares canonical http/https URL keys.
Drag reorder safety — if the DOM bookmark count drifts during a drag, the grid re-renders from saved state instead of silently ignoring the drop.
HyprMode middle-click — middle-click respects Hypr routing the same way as a primary click when Hypr mode is on.
Preview metadata saves — link preview title/description/image writes are debounced (1s) and flush on page switch or tab hide.
Open analytics index — open count and /api/track-open prefer the clicked row’s data-bookmark-index so duplicate URLs attribute to the correct bookmark.
Arrow keys & scroll — ↑/↓/←/→ scroll the page when no bookmark is selected; grid navigation starts after Tab, click, or G+1–9 / GG.
Swipe page change — touch swipes no longer fire twice on the same gesture; pointer events are used on modern browsers with a short navigation lock.
Safe image URLs — custom dashboard background images and hover/link preview images only render normalized http/https URLs (BookmarkUrlUtils.safeHttpResourceUrl).
Recent modal links — * recent-bookmark rows and bulk-open actions only use validated http/https URLs.
Status dots on duplicate URLs — status monitoring targets the correct row via data-bookmark-index, not only the first matching URL.
Cache-bust — whats-new-v58 data version and 2026.06-dashboard-release-v56 dashboard release token; template query strings updated for Docker-mounted static files.
Keyboard nav cleanup — KeyboardNavigation.cleanup() removes capture-phase listeners on pagehide and before re-init.
